name: add_missing_recursive_vistor_on_copied_i_6092c2d4
subject: Add missing recursive vistor on copied `import` type nodes (#58165)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Copied import type nodes in declaration emit were missing the recursive visitor, so their module specifiers were not rewritten correctly. The fix rewrites module specifiers through getSpecifierForModuleSymbol and visits the existing nodes.
